The '''Z-95 Mark II Headhunter''' was a starfighter produced by the [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] and the successor to the original [[Z-95mk1 Headhunter|Mark I Headhunter]].

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], several ships of the ''Mark II'' series were used by a group of pirates in their [[Battle at TFP-9|attack]] on [[Station TFP-9]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].
